key_insight: Entire sig-jump-diffusions make expected signatures computable through linear ODEs, providing a mathematical foundation for score-based generative modeling with jumps.
engineering_relevance: The framework reduces generalized score learning for time-series and finite-dimensional data to linear ODE solves and deterministic optimization.
method: Define jump-diffusion characteristics using potentially infinite linear combinations of their own signature components.
Compute expected signatures via linear ODEs in extended tensor algebra, with finite-dimensional systems for embedded polynomial jump-diffusions.
Learn scores directly or use inverse signature matching for finite-dimensional data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical computability and embedding results but provides no datasets, numerical benchmarks, or empirical performance metrics.
watch_item: Practical implementation must address truncation and computational cost when the signature representation and ODE system are infinite-dimensional.
paper_title: Entire sig-jump-diffusions, their expected signature and applications to score-based generative modeling
